name: AR_CC_ERROR_HISTORY
description: Whenever a transaction has a credit card error that has been marked for automatic correction, the AR_CC_ERROR_HISTORY table stores the details of the transaction, its error code, and its corrective action.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CC_TRX_CATEGORY
columns.description: Transaction category for credit card errors. Based on lookup CC_TRX_CATEGORY.

columns.name: CC_TRX_ID
columns.description: Identifier for transactions with credit card errors

columns.name: CC_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code from credit card payment processor

columns.name: CC_ERROR_DATE
columns.description: Credit card error date

columns.name: CC_VENDOR_ERROR_DESC
columns.description: Payment processor description of credit card error

columns.name: CC_ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: User-enterable description for credit card error code

columns.name: CC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Corrective action to be performed on transactions with errors. Based on lookup AR_CC_ACTION_CODES.

columns.name: CC_ACTION_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: S indicates if a subsequent action can be performed for a credit card error after N number of days. Otherwise, set to  A.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVER_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Identifies credit card payment authorized by Oracle Payment Server

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Customer credit card account identifier.

columns.name: FIRST_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Y indicates transactions that have credit card errors for the first time

columns.name: CURRENT_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Y indicates current attempt at correction of credit card error. Used to identify if number of days for subsequent action (or manual correction) have passed.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRXN_EXTENSION_ID
columns.description: Payment transaction extension identifier for credit card or bank account payment processing. Identifier of the transaction created in Fusion Oracle Payments for processing the credit card or bank account payment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
